subject: Request: One-time evaluation vouchers for RFP bake-off (Novabio)
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire@novabio.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novabio.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and cost controls. Procurement asked me to formalize an ask for the upcoming vendor bake-off: Novabio needs a controlled set of evaluation vouchers (30k tokens + 50k embedding units) so we can run side-by-side benchmarks against two incumbents over a 3-week window.

Can Redwood provide a one-time voucher and confirm any usage or data retention constraints? Also please confirm whether those tokens can be scoped to an isolated sandbox workspace (we prefer not to use a shared account).

We have an internal deadline to include credit terms in the RFP appendix by Nov 30 — appreciate a fast turnaround.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dawson
Head of Procurement, Novabio

Attachment: Novabio_RFP_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@novabio.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

Claire — thanks for laying this out and for the quick timeline. We can support an isolated sandbox workspace and issue a one-time voucher, but I need to confirm the size and approval path with Ben and Finance.

High-level ask from our side: can you confirm expected queries per second and whether your test suite will exercise longer contexts (>4k tokens)? That affects which model variants we'll recommend and whether we need a dedicated quota.

I'll loop in Ben with the technical details and Neha for any procurement terms. Expect an internal response by end of day tomorrow.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

Looping in details. I ran rough econs: 30k tokens + 50k embeddings in a sandbox is fine as a standard eval package for an RFP, but because this is a competitive bake-off we should gate the voucher on two things: (1) a short mutual action plan with milestone dates and (2) commitment to not use the credits for production traffic or redistribution.

I want to flag an exception request: Novabio is asking for an isolated workspace plus retention waiver (they want logs off after 30 days). Standard policy is 90 days unless Legal signs off. Markus — can we approve 30-day retention for this deal? If not, we'll propose 60 days.

Also attaching a usage_projection.xlsx to model cost impact if they exercise full credits.

- Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_projection.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

Agree with Ben on the gating. Procurement will also want an indemnity clause and confirmation we will not provide any custom model training as part of the voucher. If they need shorter retention, Legal needs to sign an addendum stating scope and auditability.

Markus, happy to draft the addendum language if you give the green light for 30-day retention. If not approved, I'll propose 60 days with standard audit window.

Priyom — I drafted suggested wording for the mutual action plan. If Claire can sign off on milestones (kickoff, weekly sync, final delivery), we can attach that to the voucher.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Sales Operations

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

I approve a one-time voucher sized at 30k tokens + 50k embeddings scoped to an isolated sandbox. Approval is conditional on: (1) mutual action plan signed by Novabio, (2) addendum limiting retention to 30 days and confirming no model training or redistribution, and (3) HubSpot deal stage moved to "RFP — Credits Issued" after the signed docs are uploaded.

Finance is comfortable with the small amount; this is a strategic account so we should be flexible. Neha, please draft the addendum and the MAP. Priyom, go ahead and confirm scope/sequence with Claire once docs are ready.

-Markus
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire@novabio.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — ask for evaluation vouchers

Claire — quick update and next steps: Markus has approved a one-time voucher (30k tokens + 50k embeddings) for an isolated sandbox. We need two documents completed before we issue: (1) a Mutual Action Plan (kickoff by Dec 7, weekly syncs, final dataset delivery by Dec 28) and (2) a short addendum that limits retention to 30 days and confirms the voucher is only for evaluation (no training or redistribution).

I've attached the draft MAP and addendum in Google Docs (link below). If you can confirm and sign by Dec 6 we will issue the voucher and provide sandbox credentials within 24 hours of countersignature.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-4392
MAP & Addendum: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cNovabio-RFP-proposal

Thanks — looking forward to working with you on the bake-off.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
